summary: Completed comprehensive testing of QuizBall V2 with Score90 branding and neon UI reskin. All backend APIs pass (100%). All frontend pages load and function correctly with proper V2 features. The app successfully implements Quick Play vs TheScore90Bot, Game History, Social Sharing, enhanced onboarding with country/age/phone fields, and 'Ball Knowledge' branding throughout.

issues: React hydration warnings for span inside select/option elements - caused by Emergent tooling injection, does not affect functionality

backend_apis: GET /api/auth/me - returns user with country, age, phone_number fields
PUT /api/users/me - accepts country, age, phone_number fields
frontend_pages: Login page - Score90 branding, Ball Knowledge tagline, neon gradient styling, email/password form
Registration flow - creates account and redirects to onboarding
Onboarding page - username, club selection, country, age, phone fields all present and functional
Dashboard - Quick Play button, Invite Friend button, Club Challenge section, Active Games list
Profile page - user info, Ball Knowledge score, Game History section, Leaderboard
Matchmaking page - Random Match, Invite Code generation, Social Share buttons (WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram), League widgets
Store page - credit packages (100/500/1000), Premium option with neon styling
Admin page - login with password, question management form with neon styling
Game page - category selection, question display with timer, answer options, feedback screens, VS TheScore90Bot display

seed_data_creation: Backend has 100 questions across multiple categories. TheScore90Bot user is auto-created on first quick-play request.

v2_features_verified.neon_ui_reskin: All pages have vibrant neon-blue, neon-pink, neon-yellow gradient styling
v2_features_verified.ball_knowledge_branding: Replaced Skill Rank with Ball Knowledge throughout
v2_features_verified.score90_branding: Powered by Score90 displayed on all pages
v2_features_verified.enhanced_onboarding: Country, Age, Phone fields present and functional
v2_features_verified.game_history: GET /api/games/history returns completed games list on Profile page
v2_features_verified.social_sharing: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram share buttons on Matchmaking page
v2_features_verified.league_widgets: Public League and Private League widgets (Coming Soon) displayed

context_for_next_testing_agent: All V2 features fully implemented and tested. Backend uses PostgreSQL via Supabase (not MongoDB). Authentication is cookie-based with session_token. The bot user TheScore90Bot is auto-created on first quick-play. Admin password is quizball_admin_2026. Test user testuser@quizball.com/Test12345 is available. React hydration warnings in admin/onboarding are from Emergent tooling and do not affect functionality.
